title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Residential Renewal Schedule and Certificate Renewal Reference
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier.**

## 1. Premium of a renewed term
For every certificate that renews under a program on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, and only for such renewals, the premium for the renewed term is the renewed building limit divided by 100 times the program renewal rate per 100 in effect on the renewal date, rounded to the cent and never less than the tier's minimum certificate premium; a new placement on the loan named on the most recently mailed first notice of a program on the Residential Mandatory Amount or the Commercial Building tier is priced by that tier's placement schedule, and every other certificate premium remains the building limit divided by 100 times the tier's building rate per 100 plus the contents limit divided by 100 times the tier's contents rate per 100, rounded to the cent, and never less than the tier's minimum certificate premium.

## 2. Mandatory purchase amount for the renewed term
For a renewal on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, and only for such a renewal, the mandatory purchase amount for the renewed term is the required amount stated on the certificate's renewal notice, the figure Tidemark recomputed there from the balances the lender reported for the renewal, or, with no renewal notice on file, the required amount on its latest issue or renewal entry; a placement under the residential or the commercial placement schedule takes its amount from the loan's latest first notice under that schedule, and at the renewal of every other certificate the amount is recomputed from the balances reported at that renewal.

## 2a. Renewed limit and premium
For a renewal on the Residential Mandatory Amount tier, and only for such a renewal, the renewed building limit and the premium for the renewed term are figured by this residential renewal schedule from the mandatory purchase amount it sets for the renewed term; at the renewal of every other certificate the limit and premium are recomputed from the balances reported at renewal.

## 3. Which certificates renew
Every certificate of the program whose current term expires today renews today, unless it carries a cancellation entry (among them the entry for a loan paid off, a servicing transfer or a building removed from the Special Flood Hazard Area, the record that the loan is no longer serviced by the lender with the building in that area), acceptable borrower evidence has been received for it, or the program is terminated (its run-off certificates stay in force to their expiration and do not renew), and all renewals booked on one day take the same program renewal rate per 100.

## 4. What a renewal books
A renewal entry on the certificate for the following term, with its term dates, building limit and premium, and a renewal premium charge on the program account on the statement for the current month.

## 5. Tool: `renew_certificate_c91c4d46`
Renews one existing certificate for a further term under the lender's master program. One call records the renewal of the named certificate with the balances reported for the loan, the mandatory purchase amount, the building limit, the new term dates and the premium for the new term; reports the program renewal rate supplied in its confirmation only (the rate is not stored on any entry); bills the premium to the program account on the statement for the current month; and raises the amount the lender owes on the program by the premium. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `forceplaced_program_id` | Reference number of the master program the certificate sits under, from the master program lookup | Identifier |
| `certificate_number` | The certificate number exactly as shown on the certificate's existing entries | Verbatim text |
| `loan_number` | The lender's loan number exactly as shown on that certificate's entries | Verbatim text |
| `outstanding_principal_balance` | Unpaid principal balance as the lender reports it for the new term | USD with 2 decimals |
| `insurable_value` | Building replacement cost value as the lender reports it for the new term | USD, whole dollars |
| `required_amount` | Mandatory purchase amount for the loan for the new term | USD, whole dollars |
| `building_limit` | Certificate building limit for the new term | USD, whole dollars |
| `renewal_rate_per_100` | Program renewal rate for this renewal, reported back in the confirmation, in USD of annual premium per 100 USD of building limit | Positive number with 4 decimals, rounded half to even to 4 decimals |
| `coverage_effective_date` | Start date of the new term | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `certificate_expiration_date` | Last day of the new term | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `annual_premium` | Premium for the new term | Positive USD amount with 2 decimals, rounded half to even to the cent on booking |

**Reply.** The renewal entry reference, the certificate number, the new term's start and end dates, the building limit in whole dollars, the renewal rate applied to 4 decimals, the premium billed with its statement month (YYYY-MM), the charge entry reference and the program's amount owed net of the charge. Both references in the reply indicate the renewal was recorded and billed.
